lhs: Dynamic update of uniform base at signed decoded constant starts.
rhs: Pad the update by fill with low clamped starts and complementary high padding.
conditions: Rank-zero signed-32 same-shape scalar base and update, one legacy integral start vector of length zero constructed by concatenating two empty vectors, enabled option and no host offload. Empty per-axis loop emits rank-zero Pad. The positive-rank matcher requires scalar concat operands, excluded by concat shape inference.
types: Arbitrary homogeneous payloads, static integral extents.
overlap: Specialization of previously reviewed UpdateConstantPad.verified with empty geometry and unit empty product. Native reachability was not replayed.
